title: GearReductionSolutionSchema
description: JSON Schema specification for Gear Reduction Solver outputs (Spur, Worm, and Planetary solutions across CLI and Web).

SpurStage.description: A single reduction stage consisting of a driving pinion (or 1-tooth worm screw) and a driven gear.

pinion.description: Number of teeth on the driving pinion gear (1 for a single-start worm).

gear.description: Number of teeth on the driven gear / worm wheel.

PlanetaryStage.description: A single epicyclic (planetary) gear stage meeting coaxiality and assembly constraints.

sun.description: Number of teeth on the sun gear.

planet.description: Number of teeth on each planet gear.

ring.description: Number of teeth on the outer internal ring gear (R = S + 2P).

planets_count.description: Number of planets symmetrically mounted on the carrier (typically 3).

stator.description: The stationary member held fixed in this stage.

input.description: The mechanical input member for speed reduction.

output.description: The mechanical output member for speed reduction.

ratio.description: Exact rational reduction ratio of this stage as a fraction string (e.g. '4/1').

is_inverted.description: True if this stage reverses the direction of rotation (only Carrier-fixed stages invert).

SpurSolution.description: Complete compound spur / worm gear reduction solution.

stages.description: Ordered sequence of reduction stages from input to output.

achieved_ratio_fraction.description: Composite reduction ratio represented as an exact rational fraction string (e.g. '10/1').

achieved_ratio.description: Composite reduction ratio as a floating-point decimal.

cost.description: Fabrication and assembly cost (sum of teeth + stage penalties).

relative_cost.description: Relative cost normalized to the lowest-cost solution in the result set (lowest = 1.0000).

is_approximate.description: True if the achieved ratio deviates from the requested target ratio.

deviation_percentage.description: Formatted percentage deviation from target ratio (e.g. '0.50%').

stages.description: Ordered sequence of cascaded planetary stages.

achieved_ratio_fraction.description: Composite reduction ratio represented as an exact rational fraction string.

achieved_ratio.description: Composite reduction ratio as a floating-point decimal.

relative_cost.description: Relative cost normalized to the lowest-cost solution.

is_approximate.description: True if the achieved ratio deviates from the requested target ratio.

is_inverted.description: True if the composite planetary cascade net inverts output rotation.

deviation_percentage.description: Formatted percentage deviation from target ratio.

SolutionList.description: Array of solutions copied directly from the web interface.

CliOutputEnvelope.description: Wrapper envelope emitted by CLI with --json flag.

target_ratio.description: Requested target reduction ratio fraction string.

target_ratio_float.description: Requested target reduction ratio float value.

planetary_solutions.description: Planetary solutions (populated when mode is 'planetary' or 'all').
